observations: Black Singer sewing machine on a matching black cast iron foot pedal stand.
The machine head is mounted on a large, ornate cast iron base.
A foot pedal is attached to the front of the stand.
The machine is shown in a studio-style photograph against a plain white background.
No brand name, model number, or serial number is visible on the machine or its frame.

claims.evidence: The machine appears clean and well-maintained in the photo, but its actual condition is unknown.
The brand name 'SINGER' is clearly visible on the side of the machine head in photo 0.
The photo shows the head and the foot pedal stand, but accessories like the bobbin case, needle, and bobbin are not visible.
There is no photo of the machine in operation to confirm the needle bar or presser foot function.
The photo shows the machine head, but the flat plate is not visible.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not stitch or may have a broken needle bar.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine in operation with the needle bar moving.

risks.risk: The foot pedal may be broken or stiff.
risks.proof: A video showing the pedal being pressed and the machine moving.

risks.risk: The flat plate may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the flat plate.

risks.risk: The bobbin case may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the bobbin case.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the machine in operation showing the needle bar and foot pedal working.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
